# Hand-written agent fixtures

These `.jsonl` files were written BY HAND, not recorded from a real run (no API key or
network was available). Shapes follow `SDKMessage` in `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`
(`sdk.d.ts`, `sdk-tools.d.ts`). Replace them with scrubbed recordings from
`node scripts/agent-smoke.js --record <name>` when possible.
